_readme: Expected-results manifest for tests/fixtures. Consumed by an external throwaway
verification runner (not committed): it copies fixtures to a temp dir, runs the
three scripts via the py launcher, and asserts every expectation below.
reason_contains values are substrings of the filter_log 'reason' field.
History fixture dates are FIXED (recent=2026-08-24, stale=2026-07-20, prune=2026-07-01);
refresh them if this suite is run long after authoring.
expected_priorities (optional) maps survivor title -> expected priority int
is a list of {title, reason_contains} that must appear in filter_log even
spoiler_scope_and_forecast_dedup pins the entertainment-only spoiler veto
and same-day-only forecast dedup (recurring open-meteo URL, not 7-day TTL).
